games.title: LIBBET AND THE MAGIC FLOOR
games.desc: Puzzle-platformer by Damian Yerrick (pinobatch). Libbet rolls under a floor of carpet tiles and pops up to find her way through the dungeon — built with the same engine tech as his NES hits.
